title: Dominoes Over Dystopia
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a cyberpunk cityscape with a glowing red Domino's pizza logo tile floating above a glowing blue one, both hovering over a bridge and colorful buildings. Below, a skeletal figure wearing a Domino's cap emerges from smoky clouds, while stylized multicultural faces line the right side beneath a large ornate sun emblem.
prompt: Surreal vibrant painting of a cyberpunk city at sunset with a glowing red Domino's logo tile floating above a glowing blue Domino's tile over a red bridge. A skeletal mascot wearing a Domino's cap emerges from dark smoke in the foreground. Stylized colorful faces with spiral patterns line the right side under a large ornate golden sun emblem in the sky, highly detailed, psychedelic color palette.
